name: Highlands Ranch
seo_title: Highlands Ranch Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Highlands Ranch, CO: the Holiday Celebration at the Mansion, Hometown Holiday, Santa at the library and a gingerbread house party.
lede: Highlands Ranch celebrates with a free Holiday Celebration at the historic Mansion, a Hometown Holiday festival at Town Center and Santa story times at the library.
celebrates: Highlands Ranch has two big free days. The Highlands Ranch Metro District and the Highlands Ranch Mansion hold the Holiday Celebration on Saturday, December 5, with horse drawn hayrides, Santa Claus, face painting, reindeer games, school choirs and Mansion tours. A week later, the Highlands Ranch Community Association's Hometown Holiday brings Santa photos, a gift market, music and food trucks to Highlands Ranch Town Center. Douglas County Libraries also hosts A Visit with Santa at the Highlands Ranch Library, with a sensory friendly session, and the HashTAG Gingerbread House Party adds a hands on option.
lastyear: In 2025 the Highlands Ranch Community Association held Hometown Holiday on Friday, December 5, from 3 to 7 pm at Highlands Ranch Town Center, with photos with Santa, a holiday gift market, live music, food trucks, hot cocoa for kids, holiday games and a lighting ceremony, according to the Live Well Douglas County calendar. The Metro District's Holiday Celebration at the Mansion followed on Saturday, December 6, from 10 am to 3 pm.
facts: This year's Mansion schedule has Santa arriving in front of the Mansion at 10:15 am. Douglas County Libraries hosts story times at 10:30 and 11:30 am on the second floor, and school choirs from Redstone, Roxborough, Sand Creek, Dry Creek and Cougar Run elementary schools perform in the Great Hall. At 2:15 pm the Colorado Dance Center presents selections from The Nutcracker. Face painting runs from 10 am to 1 pm and a caricature artist works from noon to 3 pm.
trains: Highlands Ranch has no Christmas train of its own. RTD's E and R light rail lines run south to RidgeGate Parkway Station in Lone Tree, passing Sky Ridge Station and Lincoln Station on the way, so rail riders can reach the south metro area without a car. For a holiday train ride, see the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden, and for Union Pacific Big Boy No. 4005, the Forney Museum in Denver.

faq: When is the Holiday Celebration at the Highlands Ranch Mansion?

The Highlands Ranch Metro District and the Mansion hold it on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 am to 3 pm at 9950 E. Gateway Drive. The Mansion's page says all activities are free, and food from the trucks is for purchase. Shuttle buses start at 9:30 am from Mountain Vista High School.
Where do I park for the Mansion event?

There is no parking at the Mansion except for vehicles with handicapped placards or license plates. Shuttle buses take guests to the Mansion from the west lot, the student parking lot, at Mountain Vista High School beginning at 9:30 am. Dogs and pets are not allowed on the Mansion grounds.
What is Hometown Holiday in Highlands Ranch?

It is the Highlands Ranch Community Association's annual holiday festival at Highlands Ranch Town Center, 9315 Dorchester Street. Last year's event had photos with Santa, a gift market, live music, food trucks, hot cocoa for kids, games and a lighting ceremony. See the listing on this page for this year's date.
Can kids see Santa at the Highlands Ranch Library?

Yes. Douglas County Libraries hosts A Visit with Santa at the Highlands Ranch Library, 9292 S. Ridgeline Blvd., with a sensory friendly session on December 7 and daytime sessions on December 8. Register each child individually. The library notes its public elevator is closed for upgrades.
Is there a train ride near Highlands Ranch?

Not in town. RTD's E and R light rail lines run south to RidgeGate Parkway Station in Lone Tree. For a Christmas train, the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden lists holiday trains, and the Forney Museum in Denver displays Union Pacific Big Boy No. 4005. Both have pages on our site.
